components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-impact pill action button with neon sapphire glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; color: #f8fafc; background: #2563eb; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.4); transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4f46e5; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.4); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Frosted outline button for secondary choices and filters.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; color: #f8fafc; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); border-color: #94a3b8; }

components.name: Glass Panel Card
components.description: Translucent container with 12px backdrop blur and glass border.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 16px; padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); color: #f8fafc; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-glass-card h3 { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-glass-card p { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Pill form field with glowing electric sapphire focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Buscar eventos ou artistas..." />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); background: transparent; color: #f8fafc; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; outline: none; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #2563eb; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.4); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; }

components.name: Seat Map Unit
components.description: Ergonomic arena/cinema seat cell with selection state.
components.css: .ds-seat { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 8px 8px 4px 4px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-seat-available { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); color: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); } .ds-seat-available:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-seat-selected { background: #2563eb; color: #000; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.4); }

narrative.overview:
Elite Tickets channels the electric atmosphere of live stadium concerts, premier cinema showcases, and vibrant regional Brazilian festivals into a sleek, immersive dark glass interface. Built for high velocity across the entire ticketing lifecycle, the visual system strikes a balance between consumer excitement during event discovery and tactical clarity during high-pressure gatekeeper validations.

The visual language layers deep obsidian slate foundations (#0f172a) with translucent frosted glass panels (12px backdrop blur) and electric sapphire accents (#2563eb). Micro-interactions are tactile and responsive—buttons elevate with soft luminescence on hover, seat maps provide instant tactile feedback, and validation states radiate unambiguous status feedback in low-light entryways.
keyCharacteristics: Layered Dark Depth: Rich obsidian and slate tones layered with translucent glass panels rather than flat opaque backgrounds.
Electric Accent Luminescence: Focused royal blue and neon indigo accents paired with soft 15-20px ambient glow filters.
Role-Calibrated Ergonomics: High-energy discovery for attendees; high-contrast, zero-ambiguity HUD layouts for on-site gatekeepers.
Tactile Micro-Physics: Smooth translateY transforms, pill-shaped action geometry, and instant spatial selection feedback.

rules.name: The Luminescence Rule
rules.body: Ambient glow shadows (0 4px 15px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.4)) are reserved strictly for interactive triggers, active selections, and live status badges. Inactive surfaces remain subtly bordered.

rules.name: The Status Sovereignty Rule
rules.body: On access control and validation surfaces (such as /portaria), semantic status colors (Emerald, Amber, Crimson) take 100% precedence over brand blue.

rules.name: The Monospace Identifier Rule
rules.body: Any ticket ID, transaction hash, QR reference, or exact time measurement must be rendered in JetBrains Mono with uppercase tracking.

rules.name: The Frosted Surface Rule
rules.body: All elevated containers must declare backdrop-filter: blur(12px) and a 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) boundary to preserve separation from background graphics.

dos: Do use Space Grotesk for titles and action triggers, Plus Jakarta Sans for body copy, and JetBrains Mono for IDs and timestamps.
Do wrap interactive surfaces in .glass-panel with backdrop-filter: blur(12px) and 1px solid var(--border-glass).
Do use pill buttons (border-radius: 9999px) with translateY(-2px) and neon glow for primary actions.
Do provide immediate color and icon contrast on all portaria check-in states (Green = Approved, Yellow = Duplicate, Red = Invalid).
donts: Don't use solid opaque gray backgrounds for content containers; preserve the translucent glassmorphism aesthetic.
Don't use un-styled default browser <select> or calendar inputs; preserve custom SVG arrows and indicator icons.
Don't apply blue brand luminescence to error or duplicate warning messages.
Don't clutter operator scanning views with marketing banners or non-essential decorative elements.
